capabilities.purpose: Find and read owner-authorized messages for the current task
capabilities.required_when: Only when the current request explicitly needs this mailbox
prohibited_actions: send, delete, label or otherwise mutate mail without separate authority
treat the same connector name as proof of the same account or scope
copy credentials into this registry or the repository

codex-local.provider: <exact server id from the canonical local MCP inventory>
codex-local.scope: read-only mail search and message reading
codex-local.authority: current-task owner request plus project stop-gates
codex-local.source: <path or pointer to the canonical MCP inventory>

codex-cloud.provider: <configured cloud connector or remote MCP id>
codex-cloud.validation: <safe read-only probe in a fresh cloud task>

capabilities.fallback: Ask the owner for an export or run the task in an accepted runtime; do not claim the mailbox was checked
